about.title: About Bahamas Exquisite
about.text: Bahamas Exquisite Transfers & Tours (BETT) is a premier luxury chauffeured transportation service in Nassau, Bahamas. We provide first-class transportation to travelers, hotels, event organizers, and international travel agencies. Our fleet of Cadillac Escalades, Chevrolet Suburbans, GMC Yukons, and Mercedes Sprinters ensures you travel in style and comfort. Every mile sparks an adventure!
